priorCase.rankRationale: King Yuan Electronics should move up because HBM/chiplet advanced packaging and OSAT capacity is more directly connected to the 2027 AI compute bottleneck than its current rank 16 implies, with current company-specific evidence; 7.8% YTD and $11.2B market cap do not fully offset the catalyst.
